name: Cursed Week
text: Every object that walks in is cursed. Buyers pay 30% more for them.

name: Lean Week
text: You start with 40% less cash, but every tool takes half the time.

name: Midnight Table Week
text: Two table games a night, and sealed lots cost half.

name: Haggler's Week
text: One seller type only, and sellers wait much longer to settle.

name: Storm Season
text: Every night from the second has a dusk event.

name: Quiet Week
text: No spells at all, but the wake comes 30% later.

name: Long Nights Week
text: Days are 30% longer. Curses stir 50% more each night.

name: Inheritance Week
text: A cursed object is already on the shelf. Rent is 10% higher.
